result:
Everything looks good. Both typecheck and the test suite pass.

I made the Excerpt field optional end-to-end. `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` now normalizes a missing/blank/whitespace-only excerpt to `undefined` (a provided one is still trimmed and required to fit 500 chars). A new pure helper, `app/Support/excerpt.ts` (`deriveExcerpt`), implements the 140-character, word-safe truncation rule with a single `…` ellipsis. `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`'s `store()` and `update()` now fall back to `deriveExcerpt(data.body)` whenever `data.excerpt` is `undefined`, so create always saves a non-empty excerpt and an edit that blanks the field re-derives it from the new body. The New/Edit post forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/{New,Edit}.tsx`) relabel the field "Excerpt (optional)" with a hint placeholder; regenerating `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` via `bun run codegen` picked up the now-optional `excerpt` type. Added `tests/excerpt.test.ts` (covering both worked examples plus edge cases) and `tests/PostValidator.test.ts` (covering the optional/derivation normalization and unchanged title/body validation); `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (14 tests, 0 failures).
